steps.text: A sculpted dragon is a living creature, which these tools can't model. I can build the closest version: a print-in-place articulated chain. It would be about 180 mm long, with segments that flex and wiggle off the plate, a tapered tail, and a simple block for the head, with no sculpted scales, wings or face.

args.title: Dragon version
args.question: Which version should I build? All options are about 180 mm nose to tail and print in place.

Head is a plain block with no sculpted features, as agreed.
